name: server
description: A simple real-time chat room built with Express, SQLite and Socket.IO

scripts.test: node --check server/app.js && node --check server/db.js && node --check client/scripts/login.js && node --check client/scripts/main.js && node --test test/api.test.js
scripts.submission: zip -r -FS FSE-Chat-Room-submission.zip client server test .env.example .gitignore MYPROMPTS.md README.md package.json package-lock.json -x 'node_modules/*' '.env' '.vscode/*' 'server/models/chat.db*' '*/.DS_Store' '__MACOSX/*' 'FSE-Chat-Room-submission.zip'
